date_published.why: The quote is the rule file date with the Department of State; the Board's adoption vote was on 16 Sep 2026 (press release). Filing date is a defensible issue date and the notes give both.

summary_claims.claim: Boards of trustees must adopt AI policies covering compliance with laws, parent notice for minors, academic integrity on graded work, approved tools and an AI literacy framework
tools meant to meet social needs or simulate friendship are not AI instructional tools

scope.note: Binding state rule on AI use policies at colleges; safety content is moderate but AI-specific.

note: Effective 20 Oct 2026, so 'Adopted, not yet in force' holds today. Quotes verified; level C only because flrules.org is not yet a listed official host. Filing date 30 Sep used as date_published; the Board's adoption was 16 Sep.
